_comment: Lifecycle violations accepted as the current state of the world, keyed by tools/lint_lifecycle.py's exact error string. The linter ratchets against this file in both directions: a violation not listed here fails CI, and a listed violation that no longer occurs ALSO fails CI until it is pruned -- the list can only shrink, and a stale entry left behind would silently absorb a later regression with the same identity. Every entry carries its rationale as the value.
